canonical_rationale: Only root with a single loop, a single tool-schema source, borrowed containment with shadow detection, evidence sealing and a green deterministic suite (101 tests). PROGRAMMER-BUILD-ROOT holds duplicated runners (shadowing hazard). GENERALISTA-ROOT is organ donor.

capability_map.mission_intake: PARTIAL  step1.load_mission is strict and safe, but the mission schema has no PRE/POST discrimination field and no ticket notion.
capability_map.workspace_worktree: WORKING  git worktree + copy fallback, kind recorded, source repo never touched.
capability_map.model_provider: PARTIAL  Ollama only. No token accounting. No Luna/Claude route. Codex adapter orphaned in GATE-A-WS.
capability_map.turn_loop: PARTIAL  single loop, correct 4-class failure taxonomy, but budget frozen at 12 turns.
capability_map.tools: BROKEN   7 tools, no descriptions in the provider schema (description == name).
capability_map.search: PARTIAL  grep works; no list_dir at all, so directories cannot be enumerated.
capability_map.tracing: PARTIAL  list_symbols per file only. No cross-file reference tracing.
capability_map.edit: WORKING  unique-match edit, syntax-checked, atomic, multi-edit safe.
capability_map.execution: BROKEN   run_tests only, pytest only, paths must resolve inside repo. No arbitrary command, so no reproduce/debug.
capability_map.observation: PARTIAL  test stdout tail returned; nothing else observable.
capability_map.replanning: PARTIAL  errors do feed back, but 12 turns and aggressive elision starve it.
capability_map.tests: WORKING  argv array, shell=False, timeout, bounded output.
capability_map.behavioral_verification: MISSING  Behavioral Oracle exists in its own root and is never invoked by the loop.
capability_map.rollback: WORKING  the box is the rollback; preserve-on-failure.
capability_map.evidence: PARTIAL  sealed per mission, but no PRE state and no reproduction recipe.
capability_map.telemetry: PARTIAL  mission lifecycle only. No tokens, no cost, no model class split.
capability_map.model_escalation: MISSING  no routing of any kind.
capability_map.commit_handoff: MISSING  no close-out step at all.
capability_map.explorer_integration: MISSING  not exposed as a tool.
capability_map.containment: WORKING  programmer.guard on every path, shadow detection at import, HarnessInvalid rather than degrade.

findings.evidence: All five STEP1 mission repos (ga03,ga04,ga06,ga07,ga08) contain the target file already implemented; targeted acceptance passes PRE (ga04 tests/test_scope.py 15 passed, ga03 tests/test_edit_channel.py 26 passed). STEP1_REPORT.md records 5/5 tester_pass with every run BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.
findings.impact: The only capability measurement ever taken on this harness is void. 5/5 is an artifact of a solved corpus, not a model result.
findings.cause: Corpus repos were snapshotted in POST state. Harness never checks that the task is unsolved before running.
findings.fix: Add a PRE-discrimination gate: run acceptance on the pristine workspace before the loop. PRE PASS on a change-requiring objective => NON_DISCRIMINATING, never a model score. Verdict becomes (PRE fail AND POST pass).

findings.evidence: native_schema() emits description == name for every tool and no parameter descriptions. qwen2.5-coder:7b scored 0/5 with 12/12 invalid calls in all three protocol-A runs.
findings.impact: Small local models are asked to drive an undocumented API. Model qualification measures guessing.
findings.cause: Schema generated mechanically from SPECS with no prose.
findings.fix: Real per-tool and per-parameter descriptions, generated from a single source alongside SPECS.

findings.evidence: SPECS has no list_dir. INVARIANTS.md I4 freezes seven tools and no more.
findings.impact: The agent cannot enumerate a directory. It must guess filenames or grep blindly. Repo exploration is crippled.
findings.cause: Contract froze the tool set to the screen's needs; a prior list_dir crashed on files and was deleted rather than fixed.
findings.fix: Implement list_dir as a total function.

findings.evidence: Only tool that executes is run_tests; argv is fixed to [python,-B,-m,pytest,-q,*node_ids] and every node id must resolve inside the repo.
findings.impact: No RUN/OBSERVE/DEBUG cycle. The agent cannot reproduce a bug, print a value, or check behavior outside the declared suite.
findings.fix: Add a bounded run tool: argv array, shell=False, interpreter allowlist, cwd pinned to workspace, timeout, bounded output.
findings.risk: medium - execution surface. Mitigated by allowlist, no shell, workspace cwd, containment already in place.

findings.evidence: allowed = set(write_scope) | set(allowed_new_files); membership is exact string equality on relative paths.
findings.impact: The agent can only create files the mission author named in advance. Creating files when necessary, and most multi-file work, are impossible.
findings.cause: Scope modelled as a path list rather than a scope language.
findings.fix: Scope entries become patterns: exact path, dir/ prefix, or glob. Containment unchanged (guard still resolves every path).

findings.evidence: MAX_TURNS = 12; DEFAULT_NUM_CTX = 8192. Every STEP1 run hit BUDGET_EXHAUSTED at 12.
findings.cause: Screen-sized budget reused for real work.
findings.fix: Raise defaults for the productive path and make both per-run parameters; keep the frozen screen on its frozen budget.

findings.evidence: Tool results older than 3 turns and longer than 500 chars are replaced by a placeholder.
findings.impact: Working memory is destroyed exactly when a debugging loop needs it.
findings.fix: Make keep-turns and threshold parameters; raise them with the context budget.

findings.evidence: OllamaProvider.chat discards prompt_eval_count/eval_count. Telemetry records mission lifecycle only.
findings.impact: No cost visibility. Cannot compare LOCAL vs LUNA vs CLAUDE, which is an explicit project requirement.
findings.fix: Provider returns per-call usage; loop accumulates; record carries a cost block tagged by model class.

findings.evidence: Behavioral Oracle is a separate root, never imported by localprog. Verdict is pytest exit code alone.
findings.impact: TESTS GREEN = SUCCESS, with no check that the suite discriminates or that unrequested behavior survived.
findings.fix: Refuse-only conscience layer: PRE/POST discrimination, public-surface characterization, unexplained-change detection. May block a PASS, may never create one.

findings.evidence: finish raises ERROR_NOTHING_CHANGED unless ctx.changed_files is non-empty; the only way out is calling finish twice.
findings.impact: No clean way to report blocked-and-here-is-why. Requirement 14 (detect when it cannot continue) is unmet.
findings.cause: Designed for the screen's single-edit task.
findings.fix: finish takes an explicit status; BLOCKED is a first-class, non-passing outcome.

findings.evidence: CLI exposes selfcheck/screen/step1 only. Both real subcommands are Gate-A instruments.
findings.impact: There is no way to hand the system an actual ticket. The system cannot be used productively even if it worked.
findings.cause: Built as a gate, not as a programmer.
findings.fix: Add a productive entrypoint that takes a ticket and produces a reviewable change plus evidence.

findings.evidence: screen_runner.py / step1_runner.py committed in PROGRAMMER-BUILD-ROOT (cf88154, 23c828c, e1760a4) duplicate the canonical loop.
findings.impact: Exactly the shadowing class that already produced one invalid-results incident.
findings.cause: Built in the wrong repo before the canonical root existed.
findings.fix: Delete the duplicates once the canonical root is confirmed productive; keep git history as the record.

findings.evidence: No routing code anywhere. Luna reachable only through an orphaned Codex adapter in GATE-A-WS.
findings.impact: No LOCAL to LUNA to CLAUDE ladder.
findings.fix: Simple evidence-based rules after a functional local programmer exists.

findings.evidence: Explorer has rank_repo/context_pack; localprog never calls it.
findings.cause: Deliberate - a mandatory pre-filter was the expensive past mistake.
findings.fix: Expose as an optional tool only if a measured exploration failure demands it.
